test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the view of the writer on one decade of the POCSO Act?

options.text: It has failed in protecting child victims.
It has brought new problems to children who have become victims.
It has made the criminal justice system more sensitive towards child victims.
It has been a complete success in controlling crime against children.

solution:
The correct answer is '**It has made the criminal justice system more sensitive towards child victims**.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage states that while the implementation of the POCSO Act is far from perfect, the criminal justice system is more sensitive towards child victims today than it was a decade ago.
 
• The passage acknowledges hurdles in the Act's implementation but also highlights improvements in sensitivity and the existence of better practices in some states.
 
• The passage notes that certain best practices from better-performing states can be adopted by others to improve the Act's implementation.
 
• The writer sees progress in terms of the criminal justice system's response to child victims, even if there are gaps and challenges that need addressing.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **It has failed in protecting child victims**: This is incorrect because the passage does not state that the POCSO Act has completely failed; rather, it mentions areas of progress alongside challenges.
 
• **It has brought new problems to children who have become victims**: This is not the view presented in the passage. While there are concerns about delays causing retraumatization, the overall tone is one of gradual improvement.
 
• **It has been a complete success in controlling crime against children**: This is incorrect as the passage clearly states that the implementation is "far from perfect" and mentions existing hurdles and the need for assessment and strengthening of the Act.
